scope: Retain the exact V10F reference pack and its source, revision, license and clean-room boundaries.
Preserve accepted V10 and V10E generation and state hashes behind the legacy generator seam.
Define Twin Crests, Asymmetric Rampart, Trench Needle and Stepping Mesa as typed product-owned 32-column recipes.
Compile each recipe deterministically to 256 bounded surface rows, PackedTerrain and a generated normalized ASCII review artifact.
Emit exactly eight independently tagged candidates per normalized seed and apply fixed structural, movement and direct-projectile admission.
Rank admitted candidates by the frozen lexicographic tuple and retain candidate zero as the fixed no-admission fallback.
Add replay-distinct nimble-knots-artillery-v10-r2 authority binding profile, recipe revision, candidate index and packed terrain.
Extend the offline V10 assessment across every V10F family, generated and mirrored carriers, both opening actors, mutation, Loomkeeper response and exact reconstruction.
non_goals: No external code, algorithm implementation, map, template, constant, identifier, image, tile or asset is copied or imported.
No WFC or property-testing dependency is added, and package.json and package-lock.json remain unchanged.
No V10F browser preview, server deployment profile, database path, reward behavior, Practice selector or Daily Challenge selector is added in stages 1-4.
No free-form Markdown or ASCII parser becomes gameplay authority; normalized ASCII is generated from typed recipes for review.
No cave, overhang, floating island, lethal gap, obstacle layer, movement rewrite or terrain-rendering rewrite is added.
planned_checks: Run the change selector dry run and selected verification over the complete stages 1-4 diff.
Run both TypeScript projects and focused V10F compiler, admission, jump, protocol, replay and legacy-compatibility tests.
Run the complete V10/V10E/V10F offline assessment and retain its source-bound local reports.
Run compliance, diff checks and housekeeping to validate reference records, source boundaries and package tracking.
Directly review the complete diff for bounded runtime work, exact replay authority, legacy compatibility and lack of public activation.

check_results.command: npm run check:types; focused V10F simulation, protocol and replay tests
check_results.detail: Both TypeScript projects pass. Focused coverage verifies all four exact recipe sequences, normalized ASCII snapshots, operation minima/maxima, 32-to-256 compilation, fixed eight-candidate output, both asymmetric reflections, admission, ranking, fallback, normal simulated jump landings, strict R2 protocol fields and versioned replay reconstruction/tamper rejection.

All 16 V10F rows pass: four recipe families by generated/mirrored carrier and player/Loomkeeper opening actor. Every representative shot mutates a blocked surface, every response planner selects and fires on that exact resulting terrain, and combined operations, events and state hashes reconstruct exactly.

The selector chose work-package/import checks, both TypeScript projects, all product suites, the complete V10 assessment, production outputs, four built-server smokes, identity/reward security, bundle budgets and the canonical phone browser phase. All selected checks passed: 125 protocol, 152 simulation, 37 Loomkeeper, 10 Relic, 78 combat, 42 Practice, 22 identity and 37 reward tests; both assessment rows passed; browser results were 59 passed with three reviewed exclusions.

check_results.command: npm run check:compliance; git diff --check; npm run audit:housekeeping
check_results.detail: Asset, runtime-inventory, generation-component, import-boundary, package-license, work-package and frozen clean-room records pass, as does the diff check. Housekeeping confirms the correctly tracked V10F branch with no gone upstream branches; manual reconciliation remains limited to preserved historical in-progress packages and failed V9 reviews.

check_results.command: single-owner direct review of the V10F stages 1-4 diff
check_results.detail: The direct review confirmed that runtime candidate selection performs only fixed integer geometry, movement and ballistic probes; the 180-plan Loomkeeper search runs only in offline assessment; legacy constructors omit all R2 fields; recipe metadata is strict and replay-bound; and no route, public selector, database, dependency or external product input was introduced.

skipped_checks: The selected PostgreSQL prerequisite did not run because WP014_TEST_DATABASE_URL is unavailable locally. Stages 1-4 add no database or reward path; CI remains responsible for that isolated gate.
The full five-project Ubuntu daily/release suite is owned by the existing 22:00 Europe/Berlin automation and is not rerun for each feature edit.
No V10F physical-phone check was run because stages 1-4 deliberately add no V10F browser route or player-visible selector.
residual_risks: V10F is internal R2 authority only. The local ?combat-preview=v10f route, phone readability/feel and any later product promotion remain separate work.
Runtime admission uses a bounded direct-projectile lattice; the larger 180-plan response proof remains offline and in the daily/release gate by design.
The clean-room record remains observed under the historical schema; the active single-owner policy permits direct implementation and review but does not rewrite historical separated-role evidence.
V10E physical-phone terrain feel remains open while the owner chose to proceed with V10F.
